observations.name: blocked
observations.detail: Running topology contains one filtering resolver and one authoritative CoreDNS upstream, not two independent controlled filtering resolvers. The member entrypoint uses --disable-dns. Faults above prove direct resolver unavailability only; client fallback/public-DNS exclusion and policy-sync failure require devstack follow-up. Android Private DNS/browser DoH scripts and member guidance are in OPERATORS.md.
